<div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2">
  <Badge color="gray">GET</Badge>
  `https://sys.poixe.com/api/vendor/earnings`
</div>

查询当前账户的供应商收益汇总，包括总收益、已结算金额和待结算金额，以及供给数据统计。

## 响应字段

<ResponseField name="tier" type="integer">
  供应商等级
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="earnings" type="object">
  收益汇总：

  <Expandable title="earnings 字段">
    <ResponseField name="total_earnings" type="number">
      累计总收益，单位 USD，精确到 3 位小数
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="paid_cash" type="number">
      已结算金额，单位 USD
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="unpaid_cash" type="number">
      待结算金额，单位 USD
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="supply" type="object">
  供给统计：

  <Expandable title="supply 字段">
    <ResponseField name="provided_quota" type="number">
      累计提供的额度，单位 USD
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="request_count" type="integer">
      累计服务的请求次数
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="integer">
  响应时间戳（Unix 秒）
</ResponseField>
